name: Gesztely (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gesztely: a blue shield with a yellow figure holding a sword, with a helm, a sabre crest and red, yellow and blue mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gesztely arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
